description: List the activity of the caller's organization, newest first and at most 200 events, as the web app's Activity panel shows it: campaign changes, requests, and funding, proposal deliveries and answers, signed hires and payouts, handle claims, invitations, new members, campaign price changes, payout account changes, and credited rewards. Each event has its id, at, category (campaigns or organization), title, description, creatorName (the creator it concerns, or null), and, for a campaigns event, campaign with its id and name. recent counts the events of the last 7 days, the number the web app shows on the Activity button. Needs a credential.
name: list_activity
title: List activity
